results.title: The Pull of Gritty, Authentic Crime Fiction in the Era of AI Slop ‹ CrimeReads
results.content: # The Pull of Gritty, Authentic Crime Fiction in the Era of AI Slop. ### Will Dean on the integrity of mystery stories in a world of deepfakes and algorithmic gratification. In a world of filters, algorithms, and deepfakes, we seek out honesty and integrity. Somewhat ironically, many of them are to be found in fiction. When I switch on my phone I am greeted with a torrent of AI-generated slop. But when I seek out an alternative, a cure, a beautiful antidote, I tend to reach for a crime or thriller novel. I don’t know about you, but when I read stories, I like to sense a connection, in a very real sense, to the author. An unspoken gut-feeling that on some level, I am being granted access to some of the memories, experiences, lessons, troubles and triumphs that shaped a person’s imagination, shining through their heroes and villains, their settings and themes.
